role: AI post-run engineering integrity and scalar collector; not scientific confirmation or student design
execution: Default is metadata only. Execution requires root terminal confirmation, the explicit flag, matching auditor/criteria hashes, and a fresh OUTER output. Do not run while the benchmark is live.

numeric_agreement.origin: Quality and residual criteria are inherited unchanged from the frozen prospective producer protocol. Timing arithmetic allows ordinary subtraction roundoff; actual <=8s eligibility has no tolerance.

truth_reconstruction: Independent scalar bilinear interpolation of coarse physical velocity with constant edge padding, nodes (j+1)/2 in the padded 0..25 coarse coordinates, then reciprocal square. Scalar math.fsum/sqrt model errors; no production/helper import, SciPy or PDE replay.
metrics: Returned-state errors are relative L2 norms ||m-mtruth||/||mtruth|| and ||m^-1/2-mtruth^-1/2||/||mtruth^-1/2||. They are not the half-relative-squared metrics differentiated in the earlier initial-slope diagnostic.
coordinate_scope: Check canonical v-to-m and native-byte bindings. Ordinary float64 inverse boxes can differ by ULPs; record literal actual-native bound counts without inventing outward rounding or equivalent physical stationarity tolerances.
eligibility: Require completed benchmark/manifest and all audit checks globally, plus each row's complete status, terminal integrity flag, actual <=8s cost-complete nonfailed paid return, and successful embedded807 audit. Retain all failed, late, unpaid and unattempted rows with null verified quality/events. A terminal partial run without a complete manifest is reported with its actual failure/unattempted denominators, no verified credit and no raw-array evaluation.
aggregation: All3 jointly eligible repetitions are necessary for each case/method median. Retain all16 case/method groups, all8 cases, all24 adjacent pairs and all48 rows. No successful-only median, method-winner count, p-value, first-hit claim or8s event imputation.
limits: Recorded timing is audited against frozen code and metadata, not independently remeasured. Intermediate direction/state vectors are hashed, so their raw arithmetic is not replayed. Embedded807 objective checks share NumPy/SciPy/SuperLU; this auditor does not rerun them. One reused development cohort, not independent geology, performance confirmation, causal recovery proof, new method or completed research goal. The first v1 producer attempt remains invalid/interrupted after an imported audit initialization error; v2 changes only that bootstrap API wiring, without changing this protocol or numerical criteria.
